transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I've called us together to discuss the renewal of our borrower's $10,000,000 revolving credit facility. As you all know, the current collateral schedule shows $12,000,000 in accounts receivable and $5,000,000 in inventory. At our standard advance rates of 75% on AR and 40% on inventory, the borrowing base would support $9,000,000 from AR and $2,000,000 from inventory, totaling $11,000,000 — which comfortably covers the $10,000,000 request. Before I make my final decision, I'd like to hear from risk and relationship coverage. Are there any concerns I should be aware of?

transcript.text: Elena, I need to flag a significant issue before you finalize this decision. While reviewing the collateral file this week, I found that $3,000,000 of the listed receivables are actually invoices to the borrower's affiliate. Our bank policy excludes related-party receivables, which means the eligible accounts receivable are only $9,000,000 — not $12,000,000. I have not yet updated the collateral system to reflect this. Recalculating the borrowing base at the correct eligible AR figure: 75% of $9,000,000 gives us $6,750,000 from AR, plus $2,000,000 from inventory, totaling $8,750,000. That falls short of the $10,000,000 facility request by $1,250,000.

transcript.text: Thank you both for these critical updates. Let me make sure I have the full picture before deciding. Marcus, you're saying $3,000,000 of the listed receivables are related-party and must be excluded, bringing eligible AR down to $9,000,000. Nadia, you're confirming the warehouse-control agreement is executed, so the full $5,000,000 inventory is eligible. So the corrected borrowing base is: 75% of $9,000,000 eligible AR = $6,750,000, plus 40% of $5,000,000 eligible inventory = $2,000,000, totaling $8,750,000. That's $1,250,000 short of the $10,000,000 request. Given this shortfall, I cannot approve the renewal at the full $10,000,000. I could renew at a reduced limit of $8,750,000 to match the borrowing base, or I could require the borrower to either pay down the facility or provide additional collateral to support the full $10,000,000. I'm also going to require monthly borrowing base reporting given the collateral eligibility issues we've uncovered. Marcus, please update the collateral system to reflect the related-party exclusion immediately. Nadia, please ensure the warehouse-control agreement is uploaded to the renewal file. Unless there's anything else, I'm prepared to settle this.
